title: H1 Precision Retry Driver
objective: Build an answer-independent retry driver that starts at the live H1 candidate precision, invokes the actual embedding/log/getfu attempt, advances only through live PARI retry status, retains exact owners, and stops on live success or resource cap.

oracles: actual translated cubic embedding, S-unit log, and getfu leaves

handoff.summary: Added an answer-independent native H1 precision retry owner that rebuilds only numerical owners, advances via the translated PARI retry policy, preserves exact-owner identity, and publishes nothing on failure.
risks: The translated cubic embedding/logarithm corridor stops at 2176 bits; the actual getfu leaf is still PRECI there with its recorded deficit reduced to -2.
next_steps: Extend the reviewed embedding and wide-log corridors through the next live PARI transition (3264 bits), then rerun this unchanged driver to seek live success.
